summary: To build a powerful digital assistant, you must first upgrade to a **paid AI subscription** and establish a permanent storage system like **Obsidian** to serve as your central database. Next, you must define **core identity files** that instruct the artificial intelligence on your personal background, preferred communication style, and specific role. After setting up this foundation, you need to **organize your vault** using structured folders for projects, meetings, and daily notes so the system can accurately process information without getting overwhelmed. Finally, you can **automate daily updates and organization** to continuously refine your database, allowing the artificial intelligence to learn, adapt, and efficiently manage your daily life.
